honesty_disclaimer: Evaluated strictly via content-based target recovery where targets share genres and languages with conditioned liked items. Claims of lift over unconditioned global baselines have been removed; the recommender is compared fairly against random and popularity baselines within the same candidate pool. No collaborative filtering performance (collaborative Recall/NDCG) is claimed because IMDb datasets contain no individual user rating logs.
limitations: Target films share attributes with the liked films by construction, so this is a content-similarity sanity check and candidate-retrieval benchmark, not evidence of personalization quality.
